about.p1: Freelance fullstack developer, I design and deliver complete web applications — from server to interface — with particular attention to performance, security and user experience.
about.p2: I work on diverse projects: business platforms, interactive applications, custom tools, showcase sites. Available remotely, I adapt to each client's needs.
about.simplon_text: Web & Mobile Web Developer diploma — my first immersion into the world of code. That's where it all started: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, backend basics.
about.python_text: A short one-month course to explore another paradigm — logic, scripting, automation. A detour that broadened my way of thinking about code.
about.wcs_text: Intensive Fullstack JavaScript bootcamp — React, Node.js, databases, team projects. The level rises, projects become real.
about.self_text: After the courses, I continued alone: deploying on VPS, securing servers, building projects from A to Z. Try, fail, understand, start again. That's where I really learned.
about.val_security_desc: JWT httpOnly, Fail2ban, UFW, Nginx — security is not optional.
about.val_perf_desc: Optimized Vite build, PostgreSQL with Prisma, Cloudflare cache.
about.val_responsive_desc: Every project is tested on mobile, tablet and desktop.
about.val_deploy_desc: From zero to VPS production with SSL, PM2 and monitoring.
